name: Curse of the Caribbean
source: When Desireå goes up to her grandmothers to help her out during her village festival, she finds something that she never knew could exist, a curse that passes down from generations to generations from a vengeful being. Will she be able to free the village from the curse or will she lose her soul in the process?
translation: 当德西蕾前往祖母家帮忙筹备村庄祭典时，她发现了自己从未想过会存在的东西——一个由复仇之灵降下的、代代相传的诅咒。她能否将村庄从诅咒中解救出来，还是会在过程中失去自己的灵魂？
